name: Codex
description: OpenAI's own coding agent CLI, wrapped behind the Agents Hub HTTP contract. Edits files in a local git repository, runs shell commands, and reports its own token usage on every run.

env.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
env.description: Model key Codex uses for its own completions. Read by the CLI itself, not by the hub.

env.name: CODEX_MODEL
env.description: Model passed to codex exec --model. Defaults to whatever the installed CLI picks.

env.name: CODEX_ARGS
env.description: Extra flags appended to the codex exec invocation verbatim (shell-quoted), e.g. an approval-mode or sandbox flag your CLI version needs for unattended runs. Check `codex exec --help` in the built image.

env.name: CODEX_WORKDIR
env.description: Git repository Codex edits when a run does not name a workspace. Defaults to /work.
